sources.snippet: Fine-tuning a VLM means adapting a pre-trained model to your dataset or task. You’ve already seen strategies like supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference alignment in previous units, the same ideas apply here. While the core tools and techniques remain similar to those used for LLMs, fine-tuning VLMs brings additional challenges.
